title: A First Overview - Első áttekintés

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can summarize Hungary's geography, regions, and rivers in structured B1 Hungarian.
I can describe the national flag, coat of arms, and Holy Crown in an interview setting.
I can summarize Hungary's borders and explain ties with cross-border Hungarian communities.
I can use formal discourse markers (mint köztudott, ha a fekvést tekintjük) to frame interview responses.
I can confidently participate in a simulated naturalization interview (honosítási beszélgetés).
